data_gate.plain_result: The A-long data route passed on a fixed 9-symbol main-board panel. That is enough to write this preregistration, but not enough to prove alpha or run full-universe signal search.

search_design.goal: Test whether PIT quality, cash-conversion, balance-sheet, and earnings-stability signals can produce cost-adjusted same-anchor benchmark excess in the A-share main-board long lane.

entry_exit_measurement_rule.cost_model: A-share long-lane close-to-close total-return net return must include commission, sell-side stamp tax where applicable, and a documented conservative slippage assumption.

required_output_diagnostics: Report every frozen signal family, not only the winner.
Report monthly benchmark excess with Newey-West HAC t-statistics for overlapping long-horizon cohorts; monthly cohort count is not independent N.
Report yearly contribution, stock concentration, tail contribution, and drawdown.
For earnings_stability, use same-period YoY profit_dedt growth volatility only; do not mix 3/6/9/12-month YTD cumulative rows.
Report both CSI300 and CSI1000 benchmark result cells; candidate-alpha promotion requires the same family/view/horizon to clear both benchmarks.

Use the reviewed close-to-close total-vs-total amendment because total-return benchmark close values are available while same-anchor total-return benchmark open values are unavailable; this is not a silent price-index fallback.
Report industry-neutral and non-neutral views separately, with 000666.SZ retained in returns and risk.
Report the count of restatement_ambiguous_exclusions.csv groups excluded from factor inputs; abort if the exclusion list is missing or not applied.
Report failed / missing-data exclusions and do not fill missing fundamentals with zero or latest values.
Report a plain-language verdict: usable alpha clue, risk-filter-only, or no alpha.

candidate_alpha_research_only: A future reviewed run may label a family as a candidate alpha clue only if it beats both frozen same-anchor CSI300 and CSI1000 total-return benchmarks after multiple-testing correction, remains positive net of costs, is not dominated by a tiny number of names or one year, and keeps monthly excess drawdown no worse than -15%.

Because equal-weight top-quintile main-board cohorts can carry size / equal-weight exposure versus cap-weighted CSI300, any candidate label must disclose the CSI300-vs-CSI1000 gap and cannot be called pure quality alpha from CSI300 alone.
This label would still be research-only and would not allow full-size use without the unchanged 12-month forward-live ship gate.
risk_filter_or_no_alpha: If the families only reduce bad cases or drawdown without positive corrected benchmark excess, keep A-long as a risk-filter or research reference.
Do not relabel a failed family as alpha by slicing after the result.
falsified: If corrected benchmark excess is not positive after costs and correction, mark the frozen family as failed for this preregistration.
No parameter rescue, new threshold, new benchmark, or fixed-panel alpha claim is allowed without a new reviewed preregistration.

next_steps: Independent review must verify this preregistration before any signal-search runner or full-universe data execution.

After clean review and explicit user execute, the next execution package may combine main-board candidate-universe expansion, runner implementation, full-period signal run, summary, tests, and docs in one reviewed big package.

The future execution must consume the approved 191-name no-industry boundary in docs/a_long_scaled_delisted_no_industry_boundary_decision_20260605.json: no manual fill, no silent default, no dropping those names from returns or risk, and exclusion only from industry-normalization denominators.

The future execution must consume research/results/a_long_full_main_board_data_integrity_audit_20260605/restatement_ambiguous_exclusions.csv and exclude every listed ambiguous same-ann-date group from signal inputs; missing or unapplied exclusions must abort the run.

The reviewed amendment selects close-to-close total-vs-total measurement because H00300.CSI / H00852.CSI return close but no open under the existing Tushare route. A future signal run still requires Claude review and explicit user execute, and must not use raw unadjusted stock price returns across split / bonus / transfer / rights events.
The future run must not use the fixed 9-symbol panel as alpha proof; it is only the data-route proof that justified this preregistration.
limitations: This artifact runs no signal, computes no alpha, and fetches no data.

This amended preregistration records the total-return benchmark open blocker and selects a reviewed close-to-close total-vs-total measurement basis; it does not authorize a silent price-index fallback or a derived total-return open construction.
The passed audit covers a fixed 9-symbol panel, not the full A-share main-board universe.
This artifact does not authorize production, DataHub, provider expansion, ship-gate evidence, full-size manual use, or broker / order automation.
Any future positive backtest remains insufficient for full-size use until the project ship gate, including at least 12 months of forward-live evidence, is satisfied.
